start: Workout tab, 'Find a plan' (subtitle 'A plan built for you, or a ready program.')

user_sees: 'Build a plan' row, then ready programs grouped by equipment, then 'Bring routines in'
must_not: An empty group heading; a program in the wrong equipment group

user_sees: The program page: name, '<equipment> · <meta>', summary, 'Easy week every N weeks' switch, '<n> routines · <n> days a week'
must_not: 'Program not found' for a listed program

user_sees: Workout tab with the program's folder open; it is the member's plan
must_not: Two folders from a double tap; the old plan still followed

start: Program page, member wants it kept but not followed

user_sees: Workout tab with the folder open; current plan unchanged

start: Find a plan, 'Import a routine file' (a file another MettleUp member shared)

steps.action: Tap it and pick the file
user_sees: 'Routines added' — 'They are in a new folder on the Workout tab.' (or new library exercises named)
must_not: Exercises with no muscles added silently ('Left out (no muscles in the file): …' must show)

user_sees: Sheet 'You have this file already' — 'It is in "<folder>".' with 'Update the existing folder' and 'Add a copy'
must_not: A second folder made without asking

user_sees: 'Folder updated' and 'Your changes were kept in: …' when the member had edited routines

start: Find a plan, 'Bring in from Hevy or Strong'

user_sees: Settings page 'Bring in from Hevy or Strong'
must_not: A different import flow from the one in Settings

start: Find a plan, 'Import a routine file'

steps.action: Pick a file that is not a MettleUp routine file
user_sees: 'Could not open that file' with the reason
must_not: A crash; an empty folder made

steps.action: Open a program link with an unknown key
user_sees: 'Program not found' — 'Go back and pick another.'
'Could not add the program' — 'Please try again.'

start: Program already added as a folder, not followed

user_sees: 'Already in your routines ("<folder>").' with 'Follow it' and 'Add a copy'
must_not: 'Follow this plan' making a second folder

user_sees: The same folder becomes the followed plan; page then says 'You follow this program ("<folder>").'
must_not: A copy made; the other folder's routines changed

steps.action: Turn 'Easy week every N weeks' off, tap 'Add a copy'
user_sees: A second folder without easy weeks
must_not: The first folder's easy-week setting changed

start: Member in a gym follows a ready program

must_not: The program choice sent to anyone

steps.action: Share a routine file with a friend
user_sees: The file holds routines and exercises only
must_not: The member's name, body weight or history in the shared file
